title: Updating the next loaded coordinate
statement: Let $l\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{old}$ and $\mathrm{new}$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $l$ coordinates, and let $i$ be one of those coordinates. Replacing coordinate $i$ by its new word in the bank whose coordinates below $i$ hold their new words and whose other coordinates hold their old words gives the bank whose coordinates below $i+1$ hold their new words and whose other coordinates hold their old words.
hypotheses_covered: Old and new Boolean words assigned to each of the $l$ coordinates
replaced: For all old and new field words and every coordinate $i$, replacing field $i$ of the bank in which the first $i$ fields are new yields the bank in which the first $i + 1$ fields are new.
